svg.title: Guide-word scenes: F-01 Lateral control (lane centring) under its SC guide words (WP-C-03 §4), phone view
svg.desc: 14 cards for F-01 Lateral control (lane centring), one per SC guide word. M01 No Function: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C; callout: crosses edge line. M02 Stops Functioning: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C; callout: crosses edge line. M03 Unrequested Function: H-01, SG-01 ASIL C; callout: into the next lane. M04 Function Stuck: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C; callout: crosses edge line. M05 Excessive Function: H-01, SG-01 ASIL C; callout: into the next lane. M06 Partial Function: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C; callout: crosses edge line. M07 Functions Early: H-01, SG-01 ASIL C; callout: changes lane too early. M08 Functions Late: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C, covered by M11; callout: lane change comes late. M09 Function Applies Too Short: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C, covered by M02; callout: crosses edge line. M10 Function Applies Too Long: H-01, SG-01 ASIL C, covered by M03; callout: past the target lane. M11 Function is Delayed: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C; callout: crosses edge line. M12 Inverse Function: H-01, SG-01 ASIL C; callout: crosses edge line. M13 Erratic or Intermittent: H-01, SG-01 ASIL C; callout: weaves in the lane. M14 Function is Uneven: H-01, SG-01 ASIL C, covered by M05; callout: pulls to one side.
svg.text: Guide-word scenes · F-01 Lateral control (lane centring)
All 14 guide words. Chart: the function (steering torque), required vs performed. Scene: what it does to
WP-C-03 §4 · hara_model.FM · schematic, not simulation output · phone view
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Lateral control shown as active but no torque
delivered; the vehicle is not steered.
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Torque stops mid-curve or mid-manoeuvre while
still commanded, without a take-over warning.
Torque applied while not engaged or after
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Torque request frozen at its last value; steering
bias continues while the road changes (HE-02.3).
Bounded by the envelope and EPS authority.
Torque magnitude or rate above the intended value.
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Torque below the intended value: the vehicle
Assisted lane change starts before the driver
confirms (nudge) or before the target lane is clear.
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Correction arrives after the lane geometry required
it; same vehicle response as delayed function.
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Torque held for less time than commanded; same
Torque continues after the command ends (after
lane change or disengagement); same as
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Torque in the opposite direction to the command.
Oscillating or chattering torque; weaving within or
Asymmetric authority left vs right; the excess side
Scenes are drawn to explain each hazard; the plant runs are in assurance/sim §3.7. Ratings are proposals for review
until the I3 confirmation review (WP-C-03 header). Generated by hara_figures.py.
